code: # Group a has 11 rows: 2 with the outcome, 8 without, 1 missing. # Group b has 11 rows: 6 with the outcome, 4 without, 1 missing. # The run excludes the 2 rows with a missing outcome: 22 - 2 = 20 rows. # Percentage with the outcome: 100 * (2 + 6) / 20 = 40. # Odds ratio of b against a: (6 / 4) / (2 / 8) = 6. fake_known <- function(dir) {   d <- data.frame(     id = 1:22,     group = rep(c("a", "b"), each = 11),     x = 31:52,     outcome = c(rep(c(1, 0, NA), c(2, 8, 1)), rep(c(1, 0, NA), c(6, 4, 1)))   )   data.table::fwrite(d, file.path(dir, "d.csv")) }  expect_known <- function(results) {   e <- results$estimates   t1 <- results$tables$table1   observed <- c(     results$exclusions$n_excluded,     t1$events[t1$var == "outcome" & t1$grp == "b"],     e$estimate[e$term == "pct_outcome"],     e$estimate[e$term == "or_group_b"]   )   expected <- c(2, 6, 40, 6)   data.frame(     assertion = c(       "rows excluded",       "outcome events in group b",       "percentage with the outcome",       "odds ratio of b against a"     ),     expected = expected,     observed = observed,     pass = abs(observed - expected) < 1e-6   ) } fake_null <- function(dir) {   d <- data.frame(     id = 1:400,     group = sample(c("a", "b"), 400, replace = TRUE),     x = round(stats::rnorm(400, 50, 10)),     outcome = stats::rbinom(400, 1, 0.3)   )   data.table::fwrite(d, file.path(dir, "d.csv")) }  # results holds the 3 simulations stacked, with a first column sim. expect_null <- function(results) {   e <- results$estimates   sims_n <- length(unique(e$sim))   log_or <- mean(log(e$estimate[e$term == "or_group_b"]))   data.frame(     assertion = c("simulations", "mean log odds ratio of b against a"),     expected = c("3", "-0.5 to 0.5"),     observed = c(sims_n, round(log_or, 3)),     pass = c(sims_n == 3, abs(log_or) < 0.5)   ) }

PART 1 reads data, PART 2 computes results saves pbn::save_results(). pbn::end_if_fake_scenario() ends run fake scenario. PART 3 writes output real results. data_raw relative project folder, run_scenarios() runs script . pbn reads data_raw real data . save_results() checks results object writes results.qs2. stops fitted model class ?check_results lists. also stops table many rows data. d = d gives pbn number rows. code: data_raw <- file.path(root, "data_raw") dir.create(data_raw) set.seed(4) d <- data.frame(id = 1:400, group = rep(c("a", "b"), 200), x = round(rnorm(400, 50, 10))) d$outcome <- rbinom(400, 1, ifelse(d$group == "b", 0.4, 0.25)) d$outcome[sample(400, 12)] <- NA data.table::fwrite(d, file.path(data_raw, "d.csv")) # Run one of these lines to step through a scenario by hand. The choice lasts for the R session. # pbn::use_scenario("real", sim = 1) # pbn::use_scenario("known", sim = 1) # pbn::use_scenario("null", sim = 1) p <- pbn::initialize_project(version = "v01", home = ".", data_raw = "../data_raw")  # PART 1 -- DATA CREATION ==== d0 <- data.table::fread(file.path(p$data_raw, "d.csv")) d <- d0[!is.na(outcome)]  # PART 2 -- ANALYSIS ==== fit <- stats::glm(outcome ~ group, family = "binomial", data = d) pbn::save_results(   exclusions = data.frame(     step = "outcome not missing",     n_before = nrow(d0),     n_excluded = nrow(d0) - nrow(d),     n_after = nrow(d)   ),   estimates = data.frame(     term = c("pct_outcome", "or_group_b"),     estimate = c(100 * mean(d$outcome), exp(stats::coef(fit)[["groupb"]]))   ),   tables = list(table1 = pbn::table1(d, by = "group", vars = CFG$vars)),   d = d ) pbn::end_if_fake_scenario()  # PART 3 -- OUTPUT ==== r <- pbn::read_results("v01") data.table::fwrite(r$tables$table1, file.path(p$results, "table1.csv"))
